utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring my toolbox, but I keep forgetting where I set it down. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: A bunch of little fixes still need doing — the porch light, that loose gate, and a few leaky taps. I’ll pass the word around and see who can help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, I think it’s still moving along, but I may have missed a few updates. Last I heard, they were still collecting stuff for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I need to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off so I can plan the route.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still nailing that down, but I’ll send you the drop-off spot and timing as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help however I can—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s coming along nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and parts all afternoon. I’ll keep you posted if anything big changes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m keeping the repair drive list organized and I’ll make sure everyone knows where to help next. What do you need from me, Opal?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help track the next stop—just tell me the address and I’ll keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of supplies for the repair drive—just let me know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—can you confirm which supplies are still missing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate that. School pickup’s a bit of a juggle, so any update would help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you help sort donations and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. If you can bring a few sturdy boxes and some tape, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest—did the repair drive pick up any new volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, a few new folks signed up, and I’m passing the word around. We’re keeping at it and trying to get a couple more hands before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring a couple of tools over for the repair drive if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Gus—thank you. I’ll make sure folks know you’re bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the date, time, and what repairs the drive is focusing on? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m sorry, I don’t have the date, time, or repair list confirmed yet. If you’d like, I can check and get back to you as soon as I know.
